description: This file defines theming and appearance customization logic for an OpenClawChat UI, including color schemes, background layers, and platform-specific appearance adjustments for macOS and iOS.

methods.name: resolvedAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Returns a NSColor for the assistant chat bubble based on system appearance (dark/light mode) on macOS.

methods.name: resolvedOnboardingAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Returns a NSColor for the onboarding assistant chat bubble based on system appearance on macOS.

methods.name: image(_:)
methods.description: Returns an Image object, platform-specific, for the given OpenClawPlatformImage.
